title: The Animal That Can Live Forever

scenes.say: This animal can turn back into a baby. Over and over again.
Meet Turritopsis dohrnii, the immortal jellyfish. It's smaller than your fingernail.
scenes.heading: MEET THE

scenes.say: Most jellyfish grow up, reproduce, and die.
scenes.heading: NORMAL JELLYFISH

scenes.say: But when this one is injured, starving, or stressed, it shrinks, and sinks to the bottom.
scenes.heading: BUT THIS ONE...

scenes.say: Then it turns back into its baby form, a polyp. And grows up all over again.
scenes.heading: REWIND

scenes.say: Scientists haven't found any natural limit to how many times it can do this.
But it's not truly immortal. It can still get eaten.
scenes.heading: THE CATCH

scenes.say: Would you want to live forever?
